text.content:
Sect: Independent

The Giovanni are a tightly knit family of necromancers who maintain a veneer of respectable business dealings over their funeral homes, financial empires, and dark mastery of death magic. Membership is restricted almost entirely to blood relatives of the founding Italian family, with outsiders rarely permitted to join.

Disciplines: Dominate, Necromancy, Potence

Advantage: As the originators of Necromancy, Giovanni learn that discipline and its paths without the usual increased cost paid by other clans.

Disadvantage: Giovanni are widely distrusted and disliked throughout Kindred society, suffering penalties in social dealings with vampires outside their own family.

Organization: Rigidly familial and hierarchical, organized around bloodline branches such as the Pisanob, Milliners, Dunsin, and della Passaglia families, all ultimately answering to the family's eldest members.
